notes.title: THANK YOU / STEAM AWARDS
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450146/332a0493156d885dc4f97035fb848987e4033290.png[/img]

First of all, I want to say thank you to everyone who played Little Man and left a review. 
It makes me happy to read everyone's experience and see my little game reach an audience. 

I realized now that I published, a game it can technically be nominated for the Steam Awards. So, if you liked Little Man Has a Day, please consider voting for it! Personally I consider it game of the year, but I also want to give some other, smaller games (Alan Wake, Baldur's Gate 3) a chance to win. 

Vote fair, enjoy the deals and have a day. 

- [url=https://twitter.com/iMischaP] Mosman [/url]

notes.title: Little Man has a Day is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!
Little Man Has A Day🌤️is OUT now! 
[previewyoutube=O5kX1pgR4t0;full][/previewyoutube]
It's a personal, short and silly handwritten game about a little man feeling a little 'eh'. It is also the first game I made by myself. It's on the house, so please enjoy it and let me know what you think.

-Mosman
